subject: AcmeBank: telemetry export & IR plan — evidence transfer coordination
messages:
From: Paul Nguyen <p.nguyen@acmebank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:13:02 -0800
Subject: Suspicious spike observed — request for IR coordination and raw telemetry

Hi Sean / Laura,

We detected an unusual pattern of requests from a small set of tenant tokens in our prod environment this morning between 08:02–08:16 PST. No customer data appears to have been exfiltrated, but our SOC wants to do a full evidence handoff (logs + relevant traces). Can Redwood provide: 

- Full request logs for the tenant IDs I listed below (headers, request body length)
- KV cache access logs or pointer to any tenant-specific cache artifacts
- Correlated GPU host telemetry for the timeframe (timestamps, instance IDs)
- Any internal error/trace logs showing elevated 5xx or auth failures during that window

We'd like to onboard the data to our forensics team within 6 hours. We can accept an SFTP drop (details below) or a presigned S3 link if that is easier.

Tenant IDs: ACME-<redacted-3> (I can share full IDs over the secure channel)

Please advise next steps and whether you need a signed NDA/POA to share sanitized logs.

Thanks,
Paul Nguyen
Senior Incident Responder
Acme Bank — Security Operations
attachments: none
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Paul Nguyen <p.nguyen@acmebank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:31:45 -08:00
Subject: Re: Suspicious spike observed — request for IR coordination and raw telemetry

Paul —

Thanks for the heads up and the clear asks. We’ll prioritize this. High-level plan from our side:

1) Acknowledge and contain: we’ve scoped the request and are not seeing active exploitation beyond the spike.
2) Evidence collection: we’ll bundle token-level request logs, per-tenant KV cache pointers, and host telemetry for the 08:00–08:30 window.
3) Transfer: SFTP drop preferred; we’ll generate an integrity manifest (SHA256) and an encrypted archive.
4) Follow-up: we’ll share a timeline and a small postmortem within 72 hours and a full IR packet within 7 business days.

Marissa — can you lead the artifact collection (I’ve set a 4-hour ETA) and include the IR-Checklist we use for SIG/SOC2 handoffs? Laura, please prep a short customer-facing summary we can use in parallel.

Paul — if you can provide the secure SFTP account or a short window for presigned upload, we’ll start the extract immediately. If Acme requires a POA/NDA, send that and we’ll loop Legal.

Sean Gallagher
Sr. Security Ops Liaison
Redwood Inference
attachments: IR-Checklist-v2.xlsx (will attach in next internal mail)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <p.nguyen@acmebank.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 10:02:11 -08:00
Subject: Re: Suspicious spike observed — request for IR coordination and raw telemetry

Sean / Laura / Paul —

Acknowledged. I’m starting the pulls now. Initial notes:

- Request logs: exporting request-level traces + request/response headers. Expect ~1.1 GB compressed for the tenant IDs if we include full payloads.
- KV cache: we’ll provide references and snapshot times (we do not export raw KV content by default; can provide hashes and access metadata unless you require full contents under NDA).
- Host telemetry: GPU metrics + instance-level logs for the specified window.

I’m attaching our IR-Checklist (internal) and a short manifest template. Will produce a ZIP with the following structure: 
  /ACME-58/requests-logs/
  /ACME-58/kv-manifest.txt
  /ACME-58/host-telemetry/
  /ACME-58/sha256-manifest.txt

I will also prepare the encrypted archive and the transfer instructions. ETA: archive ready and transfer credentials posted by 13:00 PST. If you need full KV contents we’ll need a signed POA; please confirm.

Attachments: IR-Checklist-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), forensic_manifest.txt (text)

—Marissa Cole
Senior Incident Response Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Paul Nguyen <p.nguyen@acmebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmebank.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 11:47:54 -08:00
Subject: Re: Suspicious spike observed — request for IR coordination and raw telemetry

Marissa / Sean —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We confirm SFTP drop is fine. Provisioned the following temporary account (valid for 24h):
  sftp://acmebank-secure-transfer.acme.com/ingest/ACME-58
  user: acme_ingest_58
  auth: key-based — we’ll share the public key via the secure channel.

POA: Acme has a standing POA with vendors for evidence transfers; I will attach a redacted copy to this thread once I return to my desk (may need to redact some internal ticket numbers).

We accept the manifest-only approach for KV content for now. If further investigation requires content, we’ll loop legal and request a full export.

We’ll expect the archive by 13:00 PST and will notify you once the ingest finishes. Thanks again.

—Paul

Subject: Evidence archive uploaded to SFTP (ACME-58) — confirmation and next steps

Sean / Laura / Paul —

Upload complete. Details:

- File: ACME-58-evidence-20271116.tar.gpg (AES-256 + RSA-4096 envelope) — size 1.4 GB
- Located at: sftp://acmebank-secure-transfer.acme.com/ingest/ACME-58/ACME-58-evidence-20271116.tar.gpg
- SHA256: d2b8f4c2... (see /ACME-58/sha256-manifest.txt)
- Manifest: /ACME-58/forensic_manifest.txt (contains folder map and file-level hashes)

Per our IR process we’ve captured: request traces, request/response headers, host telemetry, and KV access metadata. We did not export KV contents — only metadata and hashes — per our default data minimization policy. If you require raw KV content we will proceed after POA acknowledgement.

Next steps:
- Acme: confirm ingestion and checksum match.
- Redwood: we’ll begin a parallel internal investigation and aim to produce a short postmortem (root cause hypothesis and mitigations) by 2027-11-19 17:00 PST. Full packet with timelines and sanitized artifacts targeted for 2027-11-23.

Paul — please confirm you’ve received and whether you need any expanded scope.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Incident Response Engineer
Redwood Inference
